title: The 5 Heaviest Aircraft Ever Flown, Ranked (#1 Was Destroyed in 2022)

scenes.text: The five heaviest aircraft ever to fly, ranked. The heaviest one no longer exists.

scenes.label: An-124 Ruslan · 402 t
scenes.text: Number five: the Antonov An-124 Ruslan. 402 tonnes at takeoff, and it first flew back in 1982.

scenes.label: Boeing 747-8F · 448 t
scenes.text: Number four: the Boeing 747-8 Freighter. 448 tonnes, the heaviest aircraft Boeing has ever built.

scenes.label: Airbus A380 · 575 t
scenes.text: Number three: the Airbus A380. 575 tonnes, the heaviest passenger plane in history, on two full decks.

scenes.label: Stratolaunch Roc · 590 t
scenes.text: Number two: the Stratolaunch Roc. Nearly 590 tonnes, with a 117-metre wingspan, the widest ever flown.

scenes.label: An-225 Mriya · 640 t
scenes.text: Number one: the Antonov An-225 Mriya. 640 tonnes. Only one was ever completed, and it was destroyed at Hostomel in 2022.

description:
The five heaviest aircraft ever flown, ranked by maximum takeoff weight.
The Antonov An-225 Mriya topped out at 640 tonnes; the only completed example was destroyed at Hostomel airport near Kyiv in February 2022. The Stratolaunch Roc has the widest wingspan ever flown at 117 metres.
Which of these would you most want to see take off?
first_comment: The An-225 started at 600 tonnes and was cleared for 640 after its floor was strengthened in 2001. Which would you have put at number one, and what should we rank next?
